walkthroughs.title: Basic Batch Demo Session
walkthroughs.description: This walkthrough takes you step-by-step through a basic batch demo debugging session in Debugger for Mainframe.

steps.title: Open Debug Configuration
steps.description:
This step opens the launch.json file in your workspace. You use launch.json to configure your debugging session. 
If no launch.json file exists in your workspace, a prompt will display at the top of the screen. Select Debugger for Mainframe: INTERTEST™ FOR BATCH - demo session from the list of possible configurations. 
If you already have a launch.json file with existing debug configurations, click the Add Configuration... button in the bottom right corner to add a new one. 
[Open launch.json file](command:workbench.action.debug.configure)

steps.title: Populate Debug Configuration
steps.description:
Populate all fields in the launch.json file. 
Consult the "Debugging Demo Sessions" page of the Code4z documentation for parameter descriptions. 
[Documentation (opens in new window)](https://techdocs.broadcom.com/code4z)

media.altText: launch.json file with originalJCL element added

steps.title: Convert JCL
steps.description:
Use the button below to convert your original JCL to the member you specified in the convertedJCL field. Enter your password if prompted. 
[Convert JCL](command:intertest-debug-dap.batch-convert-jcl)

media.altText: Convert JCL command in the F1 menu

steps.title: Fetch your source code
steps.description:
Use the button below to open a list of debug configurations. Select your debug configuration from the list to fetch your source code. Enter your password if prompted. 
[Fetch Extended Sources](command:intertest-debug-dap.fetch-extended-source)

media.altText: Fetch Extended Sources command in the F1 menu

steps.title: Start your debug session
steps.description:
Use the button below to start your debug session. Enter your password if prompted. 
[Run debug session](command:workbench.action.debug.start)

media.altText: Start Debug Session button in the Run and Debug panel

steps.title: Continue at START PROGRAM
steps.description: The debug session stops at the START PROGRAM instruction. Use the Continue button to resume the session.

media.altText: Automatic breakpoint at the START PROGRAM instruction

steps.title: Resolve abend at ADD 1 TO TASKNUM
steps.description:
The debug session stops at an abend on the instruction ADD 1 TO TASKNUM. This is because the variable TASKNUM has an invalid format. 
Right-click TASKNUM to set a new value, which must be a valid packed integer. You can also find TASKNUM under TASK-STRUCTURE in the variable tree.

media.altText: TASKNUM in the variables tree, under TASK-STRUCTURE

steps.title: Set an unconditional breakpoint at RETURN TO OPSYS
steps.description: Click in the margin next to the line RETURN TO OPSYS to set an unconditional breakpoint at that line.

media.altText: Unconditional breakpoint at RETURN TO OPSYS

steps.title: Continue and view trace
steps.description: Continue the debug session. It will stop at the breakpoint you just set. View the statement trace in the bottom left hand corner of the interface to see the path back to the abend.

media.altText: Statement trace from RETURN TO OPSYS back to ADD 1 TO TASKNUM

steps.title: Run the program to completion
steps.description:
Continue the debug session again to run it to completion. 
Congratulations on completing the Basic Batch Demo. Refer to the documentation to learn more batch debugging features available with Debugger for Mainframe. [Documentation (opens in new window)](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=broadcomMFD.debugger-for-mainframe)

media.altText: Continue button in the Debug Toolbar

walkthroughs.title: Basic CICS Demo Session
walkthroughs.description: This walkthrough takes you step-by-step through a basic CICS demo debugging session in Debugger for Mainframe.

steps.title: Open Debug Configuration
steps.description:
This step opens the launch.json file in your workspace. You use launch.json to configure your debugging session. 
If no launch.json file exists in your workspace, a prompt will display at the top of the screen. Select Debugger for Mainframe: INTERTEST™ FOR CICS - demo session from the list of possible configurations. 
[Open launch.json file](command:workbench.action.debug.configure)

steps.title: Populate Debug Configuration
steps.description:
Populate all fields in the launch.json file. 
Consult the "Debugging Demo Sessions" page of the Code4z documentation for parameter descriptions. 
[Documentation (opens in new window)](https://techdocs.broadcom.com/code4z)

steps.title: Fetch your source code
steps.description: Save your launch.json file, and press F1 to open the interface. Select the option Fetch extended sources, and select the required source, e.g. INTERTEST™ FOR CICS - demo session. Enter your mainframe password when prompted. The source is displayed.

steps.title: Set Breakpoints
steps.description: Set breakpoints in your source code.

steps.title: Start Debug Session
steps.description:
Click the button below, or the Play button in the top left corner of the debug panel, to start the debug session. If a list of configurations displays, choose your program name. 
[Run debug session](command:workbench.action.debug.start)

steps.title: Run Program
steps.description: Run your program on your CICS region.
